data.title: MICROBE-LIFT Emergency Septic Tank System Restore - Fast Acting Septic Tank Clog and Odor Removal for Troubled Septic Tanks Up to 2,500 Gallons - 1 Gallon
data.bulletPoints: 1 DOSE WEEKLY FOR 4 WEEKS: Flush 32oz of the Microbe-Lift septic system restorer down your toilet every week for 4 weeks. In even the most extreme cases, it will typically take 90 days for the bacteria to work its way out to the drainfield. After 90 days, use the Microbe-Lift septic system maintainer every 3 months to maintain a healthy and happy bacteria colony. | QUALITY INGREDIENTS AND ENVIRONMENTALLY SAFE: The Microbe-Lift System Restore contains a special blend of our highly specialized microbial cultures. Healthy bacteria colonies are essential for the proper operation and maintenance of residential septic systems. That means our septic treatment is all-natural, contains zero chemicals, is non-toxic, non-pathogenic, and groundwater safe! | WORKS FOR RESIDENTIAL TANKS UP TO 2,500 GALLONS - The Microbe-Lift septic tank system restore effectively digests grease, fats, oils, and tissues which will improve your septic system performance and reduce you septic system and tank odors! | MADE IN THE USA SINCE 1976: The Microbe-Lift septic tank treatment has been keeping customers happy and saving them thousands on costly septic repairs for over 45+ years!!
